title: Some Random Additions
description: Just a mod that adds some little changes to minecraft.
body:
This mod adds different features to the game.
Most features can be configured through the config

# Additions

## 1. New Enchantments
- Cold blade - like fire aspect, but applies freeze effect
- Frost bite - like flame on bow, but applies freeze effect
## 2. New Potions/Effects
- Freeze - it works as if the entities are in powder snow
## 3. Mace rebalance
- Mace now deals a bit less damage from first 8 block (2 additional damage per block)
- The Breach enchantment now ignores only 36% of the armor on the highest level
## 4. Wither buff
- Wither health was increased to 400 (200 hearts)
- Wither speed was increased
- At 50% of the health spawns 3 wither skeletons
## 5. Anvil level cost increase
- Max Anvil level cost was increased from 40 to 80 levels
## 6. Client side
- If you rename a pig in Technoblade, its texture will be set to the old one and it will have a crown
